name: CapillaryStressRecorder
description: Records information from capillary meniscii on samples submitted to triaxial compressions. Classical sign convention (tension positiv) is used for capillary stresses. -> New formalism needs to be tested!!!

attributes.name: addIterNum
attributes.description: Adds an iteration number to the file name, when the file was created. Useful for creating new files at each call (false by default)

attributes.name: file
attributes.description: Name of file to save to; must not be empty.

attributes.name: initRun
attributes.description: Run the first time we are called as well.

attributes.name: iterPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using step number (deactivated if <= 0)

attributes.name: nDo
attributes.description: Limit number of executions by this number (deactivated if negative)

attributes.name: realPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using real (wall clock, computation, human) time in seconds (deactivated if <=0)

attributes.name: truncate
attributes.description: Whether to delete current file contents, if any, when opening (false by default)

attributes.name: virtPeriod
attributes.description: Periodicity criterion using virtual (simulation) time (deactivated if <= 0)
